```{r Step 1, Pull in Michigan, include=TRUE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PULL MICHIGAN QWI DATA
# 2000 Q1 - 2024 Q4
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)

census_api_key <- Sys.getenv("census_api_key")

get_qwi_sector_state <- function(
    state_fips,
    year,
    quarter,
    api_key = census_api_key
) {

  req <- request(
    "https://api.census.gov/data/timeseries/qwi/sa"
  ) |>
    req_url_query(
      get = "year,quarter,industry,EarnS,EmpS",
      `for` = paste0("state:", state_fips),
      year = year,
      quarter = quarter,
      ind_level = "S",
      key = api_key
    )

  resp <- tryCatch(
    req_perform(req),
    error = function(e) {
      message(
        "Request failed: ",
        state_fips,
        " ",
        year,
        "-Q",
        quarter,
        " | ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(resp)) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  txt <- resp_body_string(resp)

  if (
    nchar(txt) == 0 ||
    grepl("^\\s*<", txt)
  ) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  parsed <- tryCatch(
    fromJSON(txt),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (
    is.null(parsed) ||
    length(parsed) < 2
  ) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  header <- parsed[1, ]

  # Protect against duplicate header names
  keep <- !duplicated(header)

  df <- as_tibble(
    parsed[-1, keep, drop = FALSE],
    .name_repair = "minimal"
  )

  names(df) <- header[keep]

  df
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Pull all Michigan quarters
# ------------------------------------------------------------

michigan_qwi <- vector("list", 100)

counter <- 1

for (yr in 2000:2024) {

  for (qtr in 1:4) {

    if (counter %% 20 == 0) {
      message(
        counter,
        " of 100 Michigan requests completed"
      )
    }

    michigan_qwi[[counter]] <- tryCatch(
      get_qwi_sector_state(
        state_fips = "26",
        year = yr,
        quarter = qtr
      ),
      error = function(e) tibble()
    )

    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

michigan_qwi <- bind_rows(michigan_qwi)

get_qwi_sector_state <- function(
    state_fips,
    year,
    quarter,
    api_key = census_api_key
) {

  req <- request(
    "https://api.census.gov/data/timeseries/qwi/sa"
  ) |>
    req_url_query(
      get = "year,quarter,industry,EarnS,EmpS",
      `for` = paste0("state:", state_fips),
      year = year,
      quarter = quarter,
      ind_level = "S",
      key = api_key
    )

  resp <- tryCatch(
    req_perform(req),
    error = function(e) {
      message(
        "Request failed: ",
        state_fips, " ",
        year, "-Q", quarter,
        " | ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(resp)) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  # Safely retrieve response body
  txt <- tryCatch(
    resp_body_string(resp),
    error = function(e) {
      message(
        "Empty/unreadable response: ",
        state_fips, " ",
        year, "-Q", quarter,
        " | ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
      return("")
    }
  )

  if (
    nchar(txt) == 0 ||
    grepl("^\\s*<", txt)
  ) {
    message(
      "No usable response: ",
      state_fips, " ",
      year, "-Q", quarter
    )
    return(tibble())
  }

  parsed <- tryCatch(
    fromJSON(txt),
    error = function(e) {
      message(
        "JSON parsing failed: ",
        state_fips, " ",
        year, "-Q", quarter,
        " | ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(parsed) || length(parsed) < 2) {
    message(
      "No data returned: ",
      state_fips, " ",
      year, "-Q", quarter
    )
    return(tibble())
  }

  header <- parsed[1, ]

  keep <- !duplicated(header)

  df <- as_tibble(
    parsed[-1, keep, drop = FALSE],
    .name_repair = "minimal"
  )

  names(df) <- header[keep]

  df
}



# ============================================================
# Retry the three Michigan quarters individually
# ============================================================

mi_2020_q2 <- get_qwi_sector_state(
  state_fips = "26",
  year = 2020,
  quarter = 2
)

mi_2022_q3 <- get_qwi_sector_state(
  state_fips = "26",
  year = 2022,
  quarter = 3
)

mi_2023_q2 <- get_qwi_sector_state(
  state_fips = "26",
  year = 2023,
  quarter = 2
)

# Check results
mi_2020_q2 %>% count(industry)

mi_2022_q3 %>% count(industry)

mi_2023_q2 %>% count(industry)



# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check for duplicate industry-quarter observations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

michigan_qwi_complete %>%
  count(year, quarter, industry) %>%
  filter(n > 1)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check Michigan coverage
# ------------------------------------------------------------

michigan_qwi_complete %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_quarters = n_distinct(
      paste(year, quarter)
    ),
    min_year = min(as.numeric(year)),
    max_year = max(as.numeric(year)),
    n_industries = n_distinct(industry)
  )

michigan_retry <- mi_2020_q2 
michigan_qwi_complete <- bind_rows( 
  michigan_qwi, michigan_retry 
  )

michigan_qwi_complete %>% count(year, quarter, industry) %>% filter(n > 1)

michigan_qwi_complete %>% summarise( 
  n_rows = n(), 
  n_quarters = n_distinct( 
    paste(year, quarter) 
    ), 
  min_year = min(as.numeric(year)), 
  max_year = max(as.numeric(year)), 
  n_industries = n_distinct(industry) 
  )

michigan_qwi_complete %>% count(year) %>% arrange(year)

michigan_qwi_complete %>% distinct(year, quarter) %>% arrange(year, quarter)

michigan_qwi_complete %>% count(year, quarter, name = "n_industries") %>% arrange(year, quarter)



# Expected:
# n_quarters = 100
# min_year = 2000
# max_year = 2024
# n_industries = 20
```

```{r Step 5, Try Last Years for Michigan Again, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# Pull Michigan QWI sector data for 2022-2024
# ============================================================

michigan_2022_2024_grid <- expand_grid(
  year = 2022:2024,
  quarter = 1:4
)

michigan_2022_2024 <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(michigan_2022_2024_grid)),
  function(i) {

    yr <- michigan_2022_2024_grid$year[i]
    qtr <- michigan_2022_2024_grid$quarter[i]

    message(
      "Pulling Michigan ",
      yr,
      "-Q",
      qtr
    )

    Sys.sleep(1)

    get_qwi_sector_state(
      state_fips = "26",
      year = yr,
      quarter = qtr
    )
  }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Coverage check
# ------------------------------------------------------------

michigan_2022_2024 %>%
  count(year, quarter)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Number of industries returned per quarter
# ------------------------------------------------------------

michigan_2022_2024 %>%
  count(year, quarter, name = "n_industries") %>%
  arrange(year, quarter)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Overall summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

michigan_2022_2024 %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_quarters = n_distinct(paste(year, quarter)),
    n_industries = n_distinct(industry)
  )
#Just not there. Will append Michigan for years 2001-2021

#Save 2001-2021 Michigan QWI
write_csv(michigan_qwi_complete, here("01_tidydata", "QWI", "Michigan_QWIData_2001_2021.csv"))
```
